dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, nǐ qù guo Chángchéng ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 去过！长城很漂亮，可是人太多了。
dialogue.reading: Qù guo! Chángchéng hěn piàoliang, kěshì rén tài duō le.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: Gùgōng ne? Nǐ yě qù guo ba?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Qù guo, Gùgōng tài dà le!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: Nǐ chī guo Běijīng kǎoyā ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 吃过，很好吃！老师，您看过京剧吗？
dialogue.reading: Chī guo, hěn hǎochī! Lǎoshī, nín kàn guo jīngjù ma?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: Kàn guo, hěn hǎokàn! Nǐ ne?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 还没有。我很想去看京剧！
dialogue.reading: Hái méiyǒu. Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn jīngjù!
